items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: they had another fellow on snare drum I can't think of his name was that Jim Mewkes is that?

ctx.x: No no no. Not at all. Wait wait wait a minute. It looks that way. Wait wait wait a minute. God damn. Wait wait wait a minute. I couldn't talk oneself. How can I just try? I couldn't talk oneself. But Kicks let me tell you a kid. He said sometime when he and I get together. I said partner? I said I'm learning how to talk good. He gave me a lesson you started. I find him out sometime you see.
Well did they tell me that Sonny was Jim's uncle though?

No. Your uncle? No. We used to know Ken at all. Yeah. You did know him of course down in the country. Oh yeah I know him so long. Yeah. I know him. I understand first. I understand. Yeah. And I said everybody and I think I'm the his teacher. But the idea of him but then sometime he used to get to talking. I said partner I say you are learning good how to talk. I said just keep on using it.
